A_target_provenance.details: Actual perf_counter_ns service measurements, not prediction-generated targets; model reconstructed from original V1 calibration rows.

B_score_normalization.details: Raw milliseconds retained; target population weights derive from inventory cells; relative-error denominator is observed statistic.

C_result_existence.details: 13200 confirmation/reference rows, 120 blocks, 240 raw files, 120 jobs/logs; independent row checks and archived hashes agree. New report, CSV, combined exact-row copy and figure labels verified. No retained-test result.

D_actually_called.details: Original evaluate(False) was interrupted before report; recovery calls frozen audit(False)/evaluate(False), with emitted values and saved report matching independent recomputation. summarize_v2 was not the actual export path.

E_scope.details: One machine, one day, two CPU configurations, 2000 distinct validation images and three repeated sessions. Target population has 6867 images and 49 nonempty size-class cells; 9 sampled cells are singletons. No local-support gate failures, but no per-cell accuracy or future-distribution guarantee.

independent_computation.quantile: inf{x: F(x)>=q}, empirical left-CDF inverse, exact rational population weights, no interpolation

warnings.detail: Frozen six point estimates pass; this is not a retained-test result, full workflow completion, conditional-cell guarantee, or QLA/vision accuracy evidence.

All three minimal probes exited 0, including mixed; original OpenMP failure was not reproduced. Isolated postprocessing succeeded, but permanent environment repair and a complete causal diagnosis are unproven.
Nine singleton cells, only three same-day sessions, and 16 calibration images above 2MP limit long-tail inference; CPU-4T P95 is only 0.883737 percentage points inside the tolerance.
No temperature measurements or continuous frequency sampling; idle gates do not ensure continuously idle conditions; metadata and source are not independent OS attestation.
This is Type-A same-family review. Required cross-family Type-B certification was not available and is not claimed.

Original image hashes checked; deduplication reconstruction uses frozen manifest dHash values, without independent pixel-level dHash decoding. Bootstrap endpoint randomness was not independently reproduced.
